comparison.objective: Sweep ceramic fragments from under a bench into a pan; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-ended squeegee grasping, coordinated sweeping under occlusion, and fragment collection versus precision key insertion, collar rotation, counterholding, and force-limited fastening.
comparison.success_condition: All four pieces must reach the pan, the tool be released, and the scene remain still for 1 s with yaw/tilt gates; candidate instead measures impact response and lock retention. Exact yaw/tilt thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Bimanual tool use is shared only generically; debris sweeping tests a different contact and coordination ability.
